sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of the lamp-keepers of a dark wood of giant mushrooms and moss domes, who carry lamps on poles. Three pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a hood of felted moss-green cloth; a lamp-keeper's round cap with a short brim, the lamp carried on a pole beside it, never on the hat; a quilted dusk-blue hood with a soft edge. Every piece sits close on the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, moss green, dusk blue and lilac, warm lamp glow, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
